                    ### Question
                    Point out the correct answer regarding B lymphocytes.

                    ### Options
                    opa. Its two main subpopulations are called B-helper and B-cytotoxic.
opb. They are the cells responsible for the production of antibodies in the rejection of an autologous transplant of hematopoietic progenitors.
opc. They are the target cells of the anti-CD20 monoclonal antibody (rituximab).
opd. They require co-stimulation CD20-CD19 for the expression of the CD3 molecule on its surface.
ope. It is the type of majority lymphocyte in the peripheral blood of patients with Bruton's disease.

### Enhanced Information (For Contextual Support):
B lymphocytes are not divided into B-helper and B-cytotoxic subpopulations. They are responsible for antibody production in the adaptive immune response. They express CD20 on their surface and are targeted by the anti-CD20 monoclonal antibody rituximab. B lymphocytes do not require co-stimulation CD20-CD19 for the expression of the CD3 molecule. They are not the majority lymphocyte type in the peripheral blood of patients with Bruton's disease.
